current_example.problem:
Which of the following ratios is equivalent to $12 : 9?$

I. $2 : 3$

II. $4 : 3$

III. $5 : 3$
current_example.worked_solution:
All of the answer choices have the second number equal to $3.$ So our equivalent ratio is of the form ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133433/assets/b3b87322d5fd449c44a7318a98837785657eb56b34d56b6d1d53b10606d27f24.svg)  

To find a ratio that's equivalent to $12 : 9,$ we divide both numbers by the same value. In particular, we need to get $3$ from ${\color{red}{9}},$ so we divide ${\color{red}{9}}$ by $3.$

$$
\begin{aligned}12 &  & : & \,\,\, & \,\,\,9 &  \\ \,\,↓÷\,\,3 &  &  &  & \,\,\,↓÷\,\,3 &  \\ \,\boxed{\text{[math]\phantom{0}[/math]}} &  & : &  & \,\,\,3 & \end{aligned}
$$

 So to get ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133433/assets/db08651fcedf5e35bbd86c608f1cda0bd0c6a6484eedaa02c34a702afb41b333.svg) from ${\color{blue}{12}},$ we divide $12$ by $3$ as well:

$$
{\color{blue}12} \div 3 =4
$$

Therefore, $12:9$ is equivalent to $4:3.$ 

So, the correct answer is "II only."
